name: Homebridge
description: The retained Homebridge core code handles already installed plugins. The original claim concerns the separate config-ui-x installer, whose package-authentication behavior is not established by that evidence.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot, not the historical Homebridge/config-ui-x release combination.
The config-ui-x repository and npm installer implementation were not reviewed; npm's own registry integrity semantics are therefore unresolved.
